label: SAFE central parity USD/CNY
basis: Published central parity for 2026-11-09. This is the reference rate, not a tradable customer rate.

label: BOC 现汇买入价 (bank buys USD from you)
basis: BOC published rate board, 2026-11-09 09:15:45.

label: BOC 现汇卖出价 (bank sells USD to you)
basis: The rate you actually pay when buying USD. Same board and timestamp.

label: Conversion spread - low
basis: Half of the measured BOC bid/ask spread: (sell - mid) / mid on 2026-11-09. Measured, not a forecast.

label: Conversion spread - base
basis: Full measured BOC bid/ask spread: (sell - buy) / mid on 2026-11-09. Used as the central case.

label: Conversion spread - high
basis: Not published. Anchored to the former 1% ceiling on the customer spot spread, which applied until it was widened in 2014 and then abolished on 2014-07-01. Banks are free to price above it now.

label: Personal cross-border wire fee
value: 1 per mille, min CNY 50, max CNY 260
basis: BOC personal e-banking cross-border telegraphic transfer tariff.

label: Cable / telecom fee
basis: Non-HK/Macau/Taiwan cable fee. HK/Macau/Taiwan is CNY 80.

label: Full-amount (全额到账) guarantee
basis: Paid by the sender so that the beneficiary receives the full amount and overseas bank charges are not deducted from principal. USD 15 if the beneficiary bank holds an account at BOC New York.

label: Documents / notarisation / translation
basis: No regulator publishes these prices. The band is an assumption for notarised translations and courier costs on routes that require them; it is excluded from the low case and included at USD 500 in the high case.

label: ATM fee per withdrawal
basis: Chinese issuer fee plus US operator fee. Neither is fixed by regulation; the published SAFE notice sets limits, not prices.

label: Offshore CNY/CNH basis - low
basis: Base case assumes no offshore basis. Current CNH basis is not published as an official daily series.

label: Offshore CNY/CNH basis - base
basis: Mid-point assumption, deliberately below the historical stress observation. Not a quote.

label: Offshore CNY/CNH basis - high
basis: HKMA recorded a 1.94% CNY/CNH disparity on 2011-09-23. Historical stress observation, not today's basis.

label: FBAR willful maximum
basis: Inflation-adjusted statutory maximum assessed on or after 2025-01-17; the statute sets the penalty at the greater of this amount or 50% of the account balance.

label: FBAR non-willful maximum
basis: Inflation-adjusted statutory maximum.

label: Form 8938 maximum
basis: USD 10,000 for failure to disclose plus up to USD 50,000 for continued failure after notice.

label: Form 3520 penalty
basis: Applies only if the money is a foreign gift or bequest above the USD 100,000 reporting threshold.

label: Annual convenience amount
basis: A processing convenience, not a legal cap and not a tax. Genuine current-account FX is not limited to it.

label: Overseas ATM cap
basis: All cards in the person's name combined; breach suspends the channel for that year and the next.

label: Cash carry ceiling
basis: Up to USD 5,000 needs no permit; USD 5,000-10,000 needs a bank 携带证; above USD 10,000 only in listed special cases with a SAFE permit.
